activity.notes: Yle recounts, from Koivunen's wartime memoir, that he became separated from his patrol on 18 March 1944 and reached a field hospital in Salla on 1 April 1944. Because the detailed survival narrative is substantially memoir-derived, ATLAS marks the bounded episode likely rather than treating every celebrated detail as independently established.

sources.title: Finnish soldier's methamphetamine-fuelled wartime ordeal - Yle
sources.citation_text: Yle recounts Aimo Koivunen's March-April 1944 survival episode on the basis of his memoir, including separation from his patrol on 18 March and arrival at a field hospital on 1 April.
